title: Migration Strategies & The 6 Rs — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces the Step-by-Step Low-Downtime Migration Cutover: baseline sync, continuous CDC delta replication, application quiesce, and DNS flip.
routing_rationale: Orchestrating database quiescence before final DNS record updates prevents split-brain writes and ensures zero data loss during cloud cutovers.

nodes.label: On-Prem Application Server
nodes.detail: Active source application serving live customer traffic.

nodes.label: Source MySQL 8.0 Primary
nodes.detail: Replicating write binlogs continuously to Database Migration Service.

nodes.label: DMS Continuous CDC
nodes.detail: Maintains sub-second replication synchronization between source and target.

nodes.label: Cloud DNS Record Manager
nodes.detail: Updates api.company.com A record from on-prem IP to GCP Anycast VIP.

nodes.label: Target AlloyDB / Cloud SQL
nodes.detail: Promoted from replica to standalone primary; opens read/write connections.

steps.title: Continuous Delta Synchronization
steps.action: DMS maintains real-time replication lag below 2 seconds.
steps.why_traversal: Prepares target database for instantaneous cutover.

steps.title: Graceful Quiesce & Promote
steps.action: Source app placed in read-only mode; DMS applies final delta and promotes target.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates risk of in-flight write loss.

steps.title: Global Traffic Redirection
steps.action: Cloud DNS flips A record to Google Cloud External Load Balancer VIP.
steps.why_traversal: Clients transition seamlessly to cloud environment within 60 seconds.

scenarios.label: Split-Brain Write Conflict
scenarios.root_cause: Old on-prem app remained in read-write mode after DNS flip due to stale client DNS caches.
scenarios.diverted_path: 5% of customers continued writing to on-prem database while 95% wrote to GCP.
scenarios.blast_radius: Data reconciliation conflict across two database primaries.
scenarios.recovery: Immediately sever network connectivity from on-prem app to source database.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Traces the Step-by-Step Low-Downtime Migration Cutover: baseline sync, continuous CDC delta replication, application quiesce, and DNS flip.
